Interface TribeVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
CountVisitor, EventQueueBuilderVisitor, TuiCardPrintVisitor, TuiColorVisitor
public interface TribeVisitor
Visitor interface that implements the visitor pattern for all classes in the card hierarchy. Each overload dispatches to the correct card type.
